check_markov_matrix: check if a given matrix is a valid Markov matrix where each row sums to 1
validate_row_sums: validate that all rows in a 2D matrix sum to exactly 1.0
test_f_gold: test the f_gold function with sample matrices to verify Markov matrix detection
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that checks if each row of a matrix sums to 1
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use Python built-in sum instead of manual row iteration
